nom: FARMACY Filling Good Hyaluronic Acid Plumping Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin speculates this serum could substitute for a heavy moisturizer or gel moisturizer, though this is not tested firsthand.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin repeatedly report relief from winter dryness, dry patches disappearing, and skin left soft, hydrated and non-tacky, though one notes the texture did not penetrate as much as hoped while on Tretinoin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including combination acne-prone) skin report good hydration and easy layering with other products, with no negative effects mentioned.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation, reduced redness, and repaired barrier, but one with eczema-prone sensitive skin reports a burning sensation and a possible flare-up.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention their age (40s-50s and up) report visibly softened fine lines and firmer, plumper skin, including reduction of forehead lines and smile lines.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles (forehead, around mouth, chin) and increased firmness and elasticity with continued use; no dissent reported on this concern.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, report strong and fast hydration, plumping, and relief from dry patches or winter dryness; one reviewer felt the texture was too watery to fully penetrate very dry skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports reduced redness after use; no other redness-specific reports are present.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive, dry skin reports the serum helped repair her skin barrier; another with eczema-prone skin reports the opposite, a burning sensation possibly worsening a flare.
concerns.spots: No reviewer reports specifically on dark spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts and even improvement in hormonal or hormonal-acne-prone skin, but one reviewer explicitly states the product makes her break out every time despite liking the hydration.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer with oily skin reports on oil control specifically; the only oily-skin comment concerns moisturizing potential, not shine or oiliness reduction.

aspects.libelle: High price relative to bottle size

extraits.titre: Caused skin to burn + complicit in genocide
extraits.texte: It was fine my first few uses. But eventually it caused a burning sensation on my eczema-prone skin. It may have contributed to my eczema flare. I also realized that Farmacy beauty is owned by P&g and I no longer consider these products cruelty-free given the situation in Palestine. I can no longer support Farmacy beauty.

I really do like this product, but unfortunately it makes me breakout every time I use it. Aside from the bumps it gave me, my skin was nice & plump. I'm not sure what ingredient is doing it or what to do with the rest of it. I hate to throw away something that wasn't cheap, but kind of have to.

extraits.titre: I like it with a caveat
extraits.texte: It sinks in well, and it smells divine, but it pills and I despise prodcuts that pill. I only used this after cleansing so it's this product causing it (ie, nothign else is contributing to it or mixing with it) So, if you rub against your clothes or touch your face thorughout the day, you may definitely see those while pilling particles. I'm not sure if they would go away if you put on another mostiruzer on top. I typically avoid any products that pill on their own as I do not want to adjust my regimen to avoid pilling but still want to use the product. The product needs to work for me, not the other way around.

extraits.titre: Great for dry and acne-prone skin!
extraits.texte: A fantastic hylauronic acid! It's very lightweight and liquidy which makes for easy coverage all over my face. I love that the pump dispenser keeps application sanitary as well. I'm not sure what it's supposed to smell like, but there is a faint honey smell - it isn't very sweet or heavily scented though, so it may not be preferred by everyone. As someone struggling with hormonal acne and dry skin, this has really been a game changer in helping my skin feel hydrated overnight and throughout the day, without feeling too heavy or clogging on my skin! Giftedbyfarmacybeauty

extraits.titre: A must add to your routine
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin with rosacea and I'm over 50. I received this as a sample and used every drop. Redness is reduced. Absorbs quickly, not sticky. Also great for neck decollete area. Builds a great first layer of hydration. Smells nice too. I have repurchased this twice now. Love it!

I'm so in love with this product. I have very sensitive, acne prone skin. It doesn't break me out, and I am actually seeing results! Getting my second bottle! I'm so happy I gave Farmacy Beauty a try.

This serum has become my holy grail. I have super sensitive and dry skin, and this has helped repair my skin barrier immensely. I use this AM and PM, underneath makeup and all, and it's wonderful. I would recommend this to anyone who struggles with sensitive dry skin, especially in colder climates.
